data.name: Haile
data.gender_notes: Haile is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Haile is an Ethiopian name that means radiance, prosperity, and success. It is derived from the Amharic word 'ha'al' which means 'to shine' or 'to be brilliant'. Haile is a popular name in Ethiopia and is often given to girls as a symbol of hope and prosperity. The name Haile carries the meaning “Radiance, Prosperity, Success” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Haile usually hope their child will grow to embody radiance, prosperity, success and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A beacon of light and hope in the darkness.
data.etymology: Haile belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Radiance, Prosperity, Success.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Haile total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
